description:
Local music and podcast and stream player, built to enhance your quality of life

Sound Center is a modern open-source audio player that combines local music playback with advanced streaming capabilities in a single application.

Whether you want to manage your offline audio library or listen to your favorite podcasts and streams, Sound Center provides all the features you need through a simple, smooth, and user-friendly experience.

Current Features:

  • Local Music Player: High-quality playback of audio files stored on your device.
  • Podcast Player: Easily play and manage your favorite podcasts alongside your personal music collection.
  • Stream Player: Search, play, and manage online audio streams.

Planned Features for Future Versions:

  • Online Music Service Integration: Support for services such as YouTube Music and SoundCloud in future releases.
  • Additional Tools: Features such as lyrics search, tag editing, downloading, and more useful utilities.

Join us on GitHub, contribute to the development, report issues, and follow the progress of Sound Center.
